title: Find Law Firm Phone Numbers in Bulk With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their phone numbers
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find the phone numbers of a list of law firms using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 9 company names went in, and every one came back with its phone number, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, phone numbers out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the contact email of every company on a list.
outroHeadline: Call every firm on your list
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API, 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Select Company name. That finds the firm's main line, for one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type Kirkland & Ellis.
A couple of seconds later you have Kirkland and Ellis's main number in New York.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 9, from Latham & Watkins to Baker McKenzie.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The phone numbers come in row by row while you watch.
9 companies in, 9 phone numbers out, every one marked Found. One credit each.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
